name: Accordion
description: A stack of headings that expand to show their content.

props.name: items
props.type: { id: string; title: ReactNode; content: ReactNode }[]

props.name: multiple
props.description: Lets several sections stay open. Default false: opening one closes the others.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Ids of the sections open at first.

a11y: Native <details> and <summary>: keyboard, screen readers and find-in-page work without script.
Exclusive mode uses the details name attribute; the chevron is aria-hidden.
